target_customer: Engineering and security teams running AI coding and workflow agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Devin) and companies exposing MCP servers to customers' agents
problem: Teams cannot trust agents to run unsupervised because they cannot see each action, cost or risky call. Stacktrace gives one console that reads sessions, detects risky behavior, enforces policy and steers agents.
product_category: AI agent control layer: fleet console and agent gateway for MCP servers

education: PhD Computer Science, UC Santa Barbara
founders.background_notes: Per YC page and launch post; former Apache Mesos PMC Chair who scaled Mesos to 30,000 nodes at Twitter.

technical_complexity.rationale: Must observe sessions across many agent tools, inventory MCP servers and skills, and enforce policy in real time without breaking agents; founders have deep infrastructure backgrounds.

defensibility.rationale: Policy and audit data create some lock-in, but several funded rivals and the agent vendors themselves can add governance features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: As of the record date agent vendors and security startups were building the same controls; no acquisition of Stacktrace reported.

market_need_then: Companies were deploying coding and workflow agents widely in 2026 and wanted visibility, cost tracking and guardrails, shown by several funded startups in the same category.

branding.domain_note: Uses stacktrace.ai; stacktrace.com not known to be owned, no purchase info found

identity.logo: Logo in a cream and coral red palette
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and punchy, imperative lines such as Keep agents shipping and Stop monitoring. Start steering.

brand_strength.rationale: A developer term that explains the debugging heritage, but the word is generic and shared with many tools, and one search showed confusion with other trace named startups.

outcome_analysis: Stacktrace is a Fall 2026 company led by senior infrastructure engineers from Harness, Airtable, Databricks and Amazon, with no outcome yet. The founders suit the problem, but the agent governance space already had funded rivals and platform vendors as of 2026, and no raise amount is public.
